test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect voice.

She said to him, "You were sleeping."

options.text: She told him that he was sleeping.
She told him that he had been sleeping.
She told him that you had been sleeping.
She told him that she had been sleeping.

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. She told him that he had been sleeping .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in direct speech: **She said to him, "You were sleeping."**
 
• When converting a sentence from direct to indirect speech, the pronouns and tenses must be adjusted to match the context.
 
• Here, the past continuous tense in direct speech (**"You were sleeping"**) changes to past perfect continuous tense (**"he had been sleeping"**) in indirect speech.
 
• The pronoun **"you"** is changed to **"he"** to match the subject (**him**) in the indirect speech.

Correct sentence: *She told him that he had been sleeping*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rules for changing direct to indirect speech:**

 
 
• Change in pronouns: Adjust the pronoun to match the context of the sentence.
 
• Change in tense: The verb tense in the reported speech changes depending on the reporting verb (e.g., past continuous becomes past perfect continuous).
 
• Remove quotation marks: Replace them with conjunctions like **"that"**.
 
 
 
• **Example for practice:**
 
 
• Direct: He said, "I am watching a movie."
 
• Indirect: He said that he was watching a movie.
